svg.title: Brightside Crew Company packaging design portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional graphic design portfolio concept for Brightside Crew Company, showing unbranded packaging mockups with color chips and dielines. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
